say:2:1510830001:1.text: There's magic energy on that glowing orb.

say:3:1510830002:0.text: It's a <style="highlight">memory sphere</style>. It holds and replays stored memories as illusions.

say:4:1510830003:1.source_cn: 所以我们看到的是<style=highlight>珀尔...

say:5:1510830004:0.text: All this romance... how did the Hunting Goddess resist smashing his skull in?
say:5:1510830004:0.source_cn: 全是无聊的爱情戏，狩猎神怎么能忍住不碾碎他的颅骨。

choice_prompt:6:1510830004.text: All this romance... how did the Hunting Goddess resist smashing his skull in?
choice_prompt:6:1510830004.source_cn: 全是无聊的爱情戏，狩猎神怎么能忍住不碾碎他的颅骨。

say:7:1510830005:1.source_cn: 这也太俗了……你的品味堪忧。

say:8:1510830008:1.text: Wait, Perseus can't use magic. So who created this illusion?
say:8:1510830008:1.source_cn: 对了，珀尔修斯不会魔法，这是谁做的？

say:9:1510830009:1.text: Reproducing memories requires a very complex ritual. Merlin, this level of skill is almost on par with yours.
say:9:1510830009:1.source_cn: 再现回忆需要复杂精细的术式。梅林，这种手法都快和你媲美了。

say:10:1510830010:0.text: Whoever cast this was exceptionally skilled. I've got no leads, but maybe it'll help us track down Perseus.
say:10:1510830010:0.source_cn: 储存记忆的施法者……我暂时没有头绪。但是它或许能引领我...

choice:6:0:1.text: I kind of like this sort of drama.
choice:6:0:1.male: I kind of like this sort of drama.
choice:6:0:1.female: I kind of like this sort of drama.

say:13:1510830006:1.text: Don't start with me. Remember his face back in Halia? The grief over Gorgonna's sacrifice? Where's the beauty in that?
say:13:1510830006:1.source_cn: 算了吧，想想之前在呼临城，珀尔修斯谈起露牺牲的表情，哪...
say:13:1510830006:1.male: Don't start with me. Remember his face back in Halia? The grief over Gorgonna's sacrifice? Where's the beauty in that?
say:13:1510830006:1.female: Don't start with me. Remember his face back in Halia? The grief over Gorgonna's sacrifice? Where's the beauty in that?

choice:6:1:2.text: You don't understand the beauty of love.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 一看你就不懂爱情的美好
choice:6:1:2.male: You don't understand the beauty of love.
choice:6:1:2.female: You don't understand the beauty of love.

say:14:1510830007:1.text: I don't believe he has any interesting memories at all.
say:14:1510830007:1.source_cn: 我不相信他脑子里有任何有趣的回忆。
say:14:1510830007:1.male: I don't believe he has any interesting memories at all.
say:14:1510830007:1.female: I don't believe he has any interesting memories at all.

choice:6:2:3.text: I'd like to see something more interesting.
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 我也想看点更有意思的
choice:6:2:3.male: I'd like to see something more interesting.
choice:6:2:3.female: I'd like to see something more interesting.
